Generate Dimensionality Manifest

Generate a manifest for the dimensionality SLURM array job.

Each line contains param_name param_value n_covariates replicate. The sqrtk scaling adds a fifth field with that value.

Run from the repo root:

python slurm/generate_parameter_file_dimensionality.py
python slurm/generate_parameter_file_dimensionality.py         --sigma-scaling sqrtk         --output slurm/tmp/parameters_dimensionality_sqrtk.txt
slurm.generate_parameter_file_dimensionality.generate_slurm_parameter_file(parameters_file=None, sigma_scaling='1k', replicates=None, deviations=None, n_covariates=None, fixed_rng_seed=4, design_file=None)[source]

Write parameter combinations to a text file for the SLURM array job.

Parameters:

  • parameters_file (str or pathlib.Path or None) – Output path. When omitted, 1k uses parameters_dimensionality.txt and sqrtk uses parameters_dimensionality_sqrtk.txt.

  • sigma_scaling (str) – Key in dimensionality_config.SCALING_CHOICES.

  • replicates (sequence of int or None) – Within-cell replication IDs.

  • deviations (sequence of int or None) – Scan-step offsets.

  • n_covariates (sequence of int or None) – Dimensionalities.

  • fixed_rng_seed (int) – Base random seed.

  • design_file (str or pathlib.Path or None) – JSON design sidecar path.

Returns:

Path of the generated manifest.

Return type:

pathlib.Path

slurm.generate_parameter_file_dimensionality.parse_integer_selection(spec)[source]

Parse 0-49 or a comma-separated integer list.

slurm.generate_parameter_file_dimensionality.write_atomic(path, content)[source]
